# seis-ganon-huida, the five bots: in CrumblingGanonCastle until A is out in FinalBattleField; bot5 goes down there
# and bot4 lifts it; bots 1-3 come out 5, 10 and 15 s after A, bot4 after lifting bot5, bot5 last.
# Letterless directives read the bots' log, 'server' the server's.
# Generated by tools/harness/seis_adulto.py: edit its tables, not this file.
#! transport ws
#! bot-arg -real -look auto
#! count joined as player \d+ >= 5
#! never script line \d+
#! never until P1 .*timed out
#! never revive: nobody down
#! count bot\d: scene \S+ -> FinalBattleField \(loading >= 5
#! expect bot5: alive -> downed
#! expect bot5: downed -> reviving: revive requested by P[2-6]
#! expect bot5: reviving -> alive: revived \(by P[2-6]\)
#! expect bot4: A held .* REVIVE sent to P[2-6]
#! count bot\d: script done >= 5
#! count server player \d+ joined: >= 6
#! never server group defeat: all
#! never server refused a connection
#! expect bot5: alive -> downed at .* in CrumblingGanonCastle
#! never bot\d: scene FinalBattleField -> CrumblingGanonCastle
scene CrumblingGanonCastle
age adult
at 0,100,0 2
until 1 scene FinalBattleField 400
@5 down                                     # inside the collapsing castle
@5 mark down
@4 revive any                               # lifts it before it goes
@4 wait 5
@1 wait 5
@2 wait 10
@3 wait 15
@5 wait 45                                  # lifted 6 s after the request
follow 1 3                                  # out: into A's scene
mark out
wait 10
mark done
